name: Prabuddha Overseas Scholarship
sourceName: Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
description: Karnataka government scholarship for SC/ST students to study abroad.
eligibility: SC/ST students who are permanent residents of Karnataka and have admission to a full-time degree at an overseas university. Income rules apply; check the official page.

name: D. Devaraj Urs Foreign Scholarship
sourceName: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
description: Karnataka government scholarship for backward-class (OBC) students pursuing higher studies abroad.
eligibility: OBC students who are permanent residents of Karnataka, for Master's or PhD abroad. Age, marks and income rules apply; check the official page.

name: National Overseas Scholarship for Minority Students (Karnataka)
sourceName: Directorate of Minorities, Government of Karnataka
description: Karnataka scheme for minority students going abroad for Master's, PhD or post-doctoral study. Applications are made on the Seva Sindhu portal.
eligibility: Minority students of Karnataka. Notices differ by community, so check the notice for your community.

name: Karnataka Study Abroad Programme
sourceName: Department of Skill Development, Government of Karnataka (KVTSDC)
description: State programme that connects Karnataka students with foreign universities, with scholarships from several government departments and education loan support.
eligibility: Karnataka students; programme rules and partner universities are listed on the official portal.

name: National Scholarship Portal (central and state schemes)
description: One portal listing central and state scholarships, including post-matric schemes.

name: State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Karnataka
description: Karnataka government portal for post-matric scholarships.
eligibility: Karnataka students; each scheme has its own category and income rules.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship (DST)
description: Government of India scheme supporting students who pursue science programmes.
eligibility: Varies; check the official scheme page.
sourceName: Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India

name: DAAD Scholarships (Germany)
description: German academic exchange service funding for study in Germany.

name: Chevening Scholarships (UK)
eligibility: Work experience and eligible country requirements.

name: Fulbright-Nehru Fellowships
description: Indo-US fellowships for study and research in the USA.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Central government scholarship for meritorious students in college and university courses, applied for through the National Scholarship Portal.
eligibility: Based on Class 12 results and a family income limit; see the portal for current rules.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
description: AICTE scheme supporting girl students in approved technical degree and diploma programmes.
eligibility: Girl students in AICTE-approved technical programmes; income limits apply. Check the official page.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
description: AICTE scheme supporting specially abled students in approved technical programmes.
eligibility: Specially abled students in AICTE-approved technical programmes; income limits apply. Check the official page.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
description: Scholarships for undergraduate students from Reliance Foundation.
eligibility: Merit and income criteria apply; see the official site.

name: JN Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship
description: Support for Indian students going abroad for higher studies.
eligibility: Indian students planning postgraduate or doctoral study abroad; see the official criteria.

name: Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation Scholarships
description: Scholarships for Indian students pursuing postgraduate study at leading universities abroad.
eligibility: Varies by year; see the foundation's site.

name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
description: European Union funded joint master's programmes studied at universities in several European countries.
eligibility: Varies by programme; each programme sets its own application rules.

name: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
description: Japanese government scholarship for international students to study in Japan.
eligibility: Varies by category (undergraduate, research student and others); see the Embassy of Japan in India.

name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
description: Fully funded scholarships for master's and doctoral study at the University of Cambridge.
eligibility: Applicants from outside the UK; see the official site for criteria.
